WHY_THIS_REFRAMES_Q80: Q80's mixed vehicle is GPU-MATVEC-BOUND, not host-bound. My earlier 'Q80 is host/sync-bound' came from the Q4 vehicle (125 ms GPU of a 225 ms token). On the mixed artifact - the actual G020 sealing vehicle - gpu_matvec is 863 ms of a 1171 ms token, 74%. Host work is the remaining 307 ms and this lane just removed 74 ms of it.

DENSITY_IS_COSTING_SPEED.claim: Compressing Q80 from Q4 to 1.4444 BPW made the kernel ~6x SLOWER PER BYTE, because mixed codecs (binary / rice_q1 / low-rank) need expensive per-weight reconstruction.
DENSITY_IS_COSTING_SPEED.net_effect: Q4 token 225 ms vs mixed token 1171 ms. Density bought bytes and lost far more to reconstruction.
DENSITY_IS_COSTING_SPEED.consequence: For Q80, RECONSTRUCTION COST is the dominant term, not bytes moved. S004 section 7 items 5-6 - reconstruction in-register, reconstruction fused into consumption - are the levers that matter, and they outrank further BPW reduction.
